text: k one more thing. check props vs items. props, where are they in the workspaces? hint: they arnt
resolution: Verified the user's hint and wrote §13 of the structure review (commit cfae782cd): props have ZERO workspace existence (no workbench source, no stream, no data domain, no roster) while items got the full treatment (itemsSource + items/voxels streams + voxel sculpt). Props instead live in FOUR hand-synced code homes: world/propKinds.ts (722 lines, legacy) + game/kinds/props.ts (791 lines, the V17 capture) + render3d/props/*.tsx hand-written mesh per prop + compile/worldGeometry.ts re-encoded colors/geometry. Worse: the two registries have SPLIT consumers — the live editor (ObjectsTab/PropertiesPanel/placements) AND compile read the LEGACY file while the game door reads the capture — a live divergence hazard. Proposed three-step fold: (1) unify on game/kinds/props.ts and retire the legacy file (hazard fix, priority right after §9.1); (2) a props workbench source on the tunables pattern (code defaults + V20 props override stream); (3) prop models from the items/voxel/carve pipeline per V24's existing ruling ('prop entries fill from the existing items/model pipelines'), retiring the hand-written .tsx meshes.
